tha-ap188:1.1: Bodhiupaṭṭhāyaka.] Nagare Rammavatiyā āsiṃ Muraja-nāmako / niccupaṭṭhānayutto 'mhi gato 'haṃ bodhiṃ uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap188:2.1: Sāyapātaṃ uṭṭhahitvā sukkamūlena codito / aṭṭhārase kappasate duggatiṃ nūpapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap188:3.1: Pañcadase kappasate rājāhosiṃ janādhipo / Damatho nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap188:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bodhiupaṭṭhāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
